summary: Executed backend + frontend + native validation for private download and native prefill/focus increment. Added new pytest coverage for /api/download security contract and added Robolectric tests for LoginScreen prefill/manual submit and FocusMotion/FocusBloom basics. Native unit suite passed with expanded count (84 tests, 0 fail, 1 skip), build/version/signing checks passed, and release BuildConfig strips prefill secrets.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses link.dataset.testid instead of a real data-testid attribute key expected by testability guidelines.

integration_issues.flow: Browser helper successful download via real fragment capability
integration_issues.issue: Could not run end-to-end success click path in browser automation without exposing secret token in tool parameters/logs. Header-authenticated success was verified via backend API tests and hash match to built APK.

action_items: Run one controlled browser E2E with real capability fragment in a secure harness that can inject token without logging it, then verify downloaded APK install artifact explicitly.
If strict testability policy is required, switch download artifact link marker to an actual data-testid attribute.
Complete real-device native navigation/focus QA (Home/Search/Library/Profile/nav/hero at 960x540 and 800x450 with long titles) since Robolectric cannot validate GPU/raster clipping fidelity.
critical_code_review_comments: Release BuildConfig verification is correct: DEBUG_PREFILL_ENABLED=false and both prefill constants empty in generated release BuildConfig.
Backend private APK route is fail-closed: missing/wrong/query-only token return 404 with no-store headers; valid header token returns APK bytes matching local build hash.

Focused Robolectric tests now exist for login prefill/manual-submit and base focus-motion behaviour, but not every requested advanced focus reversal/detach/rebind/reduced-motion scenario is covered yet.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (helper missing/wrong-token paths + responsive checks passed; real-token browser success path pending secure harness)

rca of the issue: Primary gap is test-execution constraint rather than code failure: browser automation tool requires explicit URL input, which would expose capability secret if used for real-fragment success test. Mitigation is secure token injection in a non-logged harness or pre-provisioned ephemeral token flow for automated E2E.
